Helow! Please, subscrab 🐾 to our channel 💚

Cuddle Buddies is where animals find their unique voices. They can be goofy and deep, we just let the animals speak. 

We create videos of amazing animals, and show how animals see the world around them. Heartbreaking stories, funny animal videos, rescue missions — with a fresh perspective. All the stories published on Cuddle Buddies were created together with the animal owners, with their permission and involvement. 

Cuddle Buddies was created in 2022 under the leadership of Iegor Bakhariev. And we are proud to see how the project grew from a small YouTube channel to one of the biggest animal media. Every day our team is working on bringing unique animal stories to the public. Please support us if you can. 

We’re constantly searching for new stories and new partnerships. So if you are an animal organisation, a media or you have a story to tell, you can reach out to us by the links bellow.👇
